title: The same barrels, a $22.8 billion bigger bill
unit: US$ billion spent on crude oil imports

metadata.method: PPAC monthly crude import value (report 3, US$ million) summed over April to July, with the matching volume from report 1.
metadata.keyFact: Volume rose 0.45% between April-July 2025 and April-July 2026; value rose 56%.
metadata.caveat: 2026 figures are provisional and get revised. Volume is million metric tonnes, not barrels.
